meta.title: Broccoli Park — a cosy restaurant in the heart of Tashkent
meta.description: Breakfast from 8 am, a bistro counter with 120+ dishes daily, a restaurant with live music, a summer terrace and a kids' playroom. 31B Shakhrisabz St. Booking: +998 95 501 10 10.
hero.title: A cosy restaurant in the very heart of Tashkent
hero.subtitle: Breakfast, lunch and dinner made with care for everyone. A bistro by day, a restaurant by night.
about.title: Two places under one roof
about.lead: Pop in for a quick lunch or stay for a long dinner — we do both.
about.f1.label: Ground floor
about.f1.title: Bistro
about.f1.text: The biggest self-service counter in Tashkent: pick with your eyes, eat with pleasure.
about.f2.label: First floor
about.f2.title: Restaurant
about.f2.text: Signature cuisine, a bar and warm light — made for dates, meetings and celebrations.
about.f2.alt: The first-floor restaurant in the evening
features.title: A place you'll want to come back to
features.1.title: Right in the centre
features.1.text: 2 minutes from Amir Temur xiyoboni metro, among trees and quiet.
features.2.title: Live music
features.2.text: Evenings from around 8:30 pm — live vocals and a show programme.
features.3.title: Summer terrace
features.3.text: Shady trees and a cooling mist — fresh even in the July heat.
features.4.title: A world for kids
features.4.text: A free playroom, a changing table, a kids' menu and colouring pages.
features.5.title: Healthy choices
features.5.text: Balanced dishes, steamed food and vegetarian options — tasty and light.
features.6.title: Delivery & takeaway
features.6.text: Coffee to go, fast delivery and Wi-Fi if you need to work.
menu.title: What's on the table today
menu.lead: 280+ items: from syrniki and bowls to steaks and mangal grill.
menu.empty: Nothing found. Try another word — or ask your waiter, we'll help.
menu.note: Prices may vary. Please check the current menu with your waiter.
breakfast.title: Breakfast from 8 am
breakfast.text: Shakshuka, eggs Benedict on croissant, syrniki and porridge — start your day slowly, with great coffee.
lunch.title: Lunch set
lunch.formula: salad + main + side + soup of choice + bread
lunch.note: Daily from 11 am. Sets change — check at the counter.
family.title: Grown-ups relax, kids play
family.text: We love it when the whole family comes. So we've made sure little ones have fun and parents can relax.
family.l1: A free playroom for toddlers up to ~5 years
family.l2: A changing table with nappies and wipes
family.l3: Kids' menu: dumplings, sugar-free syrniki, steamed patties
family.l4: Colouring pages, entertainers and weekend workshops
family.alt: A child playing in the playroom
evenings.title: Evenings at Broccoli Park
evenings.text: When the lights come on, the bistro turns into a restaurant: live music, a glass of wine and conversations you don't want to end.
evenings.1.title: Live music
evenings.1.text: Every evening from about 8:30 pm, with a show at weekends.
evenings.2.title: Terrace under the trees
evenings.2.text: Warm lights, cool mist and a view of the green city centre.
evenings.3.title: Banquets & events
evenings.3.text: Birthdays, weddings, corporate parties — we'll build a menu for your occasion.

reviews.title: Guests trust us
reviews.r1: A beautiful interior and a warm atmosphere. We came for dinner and stayed until closing.
reviews.r2: Live music in the evening — a great reason to head into town. The food was a treat too.
reviews.r3: Thank you for caring about kids: a playroom, a changing table and a kids' menu. We could eat in peace.
reviews.r4: The best breakfasts in the centre: the shakshuka and syrniki are superb, and the coffee is great.
reviews.r5: We have quick lunches at the bistro with colleagues — a huge choice and everything fresh.
reviews.r6: In summer we sat on the terrace with the mist — cool and very cosy. We'll be back!
